g.text: Single layer PCB trace routing | grid pitch 2 mm
Route A to A, B to B, and so on. Gray squares are keepouts.
Grid X increases right; Y increases down. No vias or trace crossings.
Trace width 0.6 mm | Pad diameter 1.0 mm | Minimum clearance 0.4 mm
Orthogonal grid routes only. Gray keepouts are 1.2 x 1.2 mm.
Research layout: geometry and connectivity only; no electrical performance claim.
Required centerline lengths (mm); locked traces must keep their exact route:
